_comment: The protection GitHub is expected to hold on main, apart from the required contexts, which are ci/required-checks.txt and are not restated here. scripts/check-main-ruleset.ts checks this file on every pull request that touches ci/ or a workflow (rules R1 to R6) and compares GitHub with it weekly in build-all.yml and by hand (--live, rules L1 to L8). NP-SW-CI-001 §6.17. This file changes nothing on GitHub: a settings change is the principal's (docs/human-input/oi-swci-54-main-ruleset.md), and this file is edited in the same operation, as ci/required-checks.txt is.
_observed: Every value was read from GitHub on 2026-11-11 (gh api repos/stevehickman/NeuroPulse/rulesets/16412379 and .../rules/branches/main). Decided by a record: the pull_request rule, its first six parameters and the admin bypass mode (NP-SW-CI-001 §6.13.1); the App bypass (docs/revisions/README.md). Observed, and decided by no record: pull_request.require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes, pull_request.required_reviewers and the copilot_code_review rule. They are stated so that a change to them is seen, not because a record chose them (OI-SWCI-54).
name: Safety

bypass_actors.who: Repository admin. Pull requests only: an admin may merge a pull request over a failing check and may not push to main (OI-SWCI-22).
A GitHub App. The records say the App RevNumberFixer is on the bypass list (docs/revisions/README.md); that this id is that App was not confirmed from the session that wrote this file.
